title: podcast-alpha library query output
description: `library query --json` prints an array of claims (this schema's root). `library query --transcripts --json` prints an array of #/$defs/transcript_hit. `library export` writes one claim per line.

link.description: Best URL for the moment: YouTube with &t=<seconds>s when a video is known, else the episode page.

date.description: Date the claim is filed under (episode publish date, else run date); --since filters on this.

timestamp.description: Seconds from the start of the episode.

tickers.description: Upper-case tickers, or private:Name. Empty for report claims (not tagged).

source.description: report = daily pick cite; ranked = weekly ranking claim.

score.description: Weekly episode score; null for report claims.

transcript_path.description: Local markdown transcript on the machine that ingested it.

matched_by.description: With a ticker filter: tag = the claim is tagged with it; text = untagged claim whose text names the symbol (upper-case whole word of 3+ chars, or $SYM). null when no ticker filter was used.

timestamp.description: Start of the matching ~60 s window, seconds.

snippet.description: Matching words wrapped in **. Whisper/caption text: names may be misspelled.
